description.en: The project description, used for filtering.

description.zh: 是否获取Project 配额信息
description.en: Specifies whether to retrieve the project quota information.
The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0.
The name of the project. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。默认值为100，最多返回500个Project信息。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 100. A maximum of 500 project entries can be returned.

descriptions.zh:
### 接口说明
Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
descriptions.en:
### Operation description
The Host consists of the project name and the Simple Log Service endpoint. You must specify the project in the Host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-project --project-name ali-test-project --offset 0 --size 10 --resource-group-id rg-aekzf000000sxby --fetch-quota false --description abc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET / --region cn-hangzhou --offset 0 --size 10 --fetchQuota false --description abc --resourceGroupId 'rg-aekzf000000sxby' --projectName 'ali-test-project' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
